Ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati 4 katesh ( orientim lindje dhe juge-perendim)
Apartamenti eshte i restauruar totalisht suvatime elektrike hidraulike multistrat, tualet inkaso, dyer te reja, dritare plastile dopioxham termike, parket, patinime lyerje etj.
Siperfaqa eshte rreth 70 metra por ne certifikat shkruan 58 m².

title_en: Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, Bardhyl St
description_en: It is located on the 3rd floor of a 4-story building (east and south-west orientation). The apartment has been completely restored, multi-layer hydraulic plastering, flush toilet, new doors, thermal double-glazed plastic windows, parquet, paint coatings, etc. The surface is about 70 meters, but the certificate says 58 m². The price is €148,000
